gloss_chirho: † II. מָעוֹן  n.pr. 1.   loc. in Judah Jos 15:55 (P), 1 S 25:2 (𝔊 Μααν, Μαων), now Maʿîn (BuhlGeogr. 163 and reff.), 8 m
† מַעֲכָה  n.pr.m., f. et gent. 1.   n.pr.m. 𝔊 Μ(ο)ωχα, Μα(α)χα: a.  son of Nahor by his concubine רְאוּמָה Gn 22:22 (J)
† מַעֲכָתִי  adj.gent. הַמּ׳ 1 Ch 4:19; so בֶּן־הַמַּעֲכָתִי 2 S 23:34 of one of David’s heroes, We del. בן; read prob.
מַעֲלֶה19  n.m. Is 15:5 ascent;—מ׳ Ne 12:37; cstr. מַעֲלֵה Jos 10:10 + 14 times; מַעֲלָו֯ Ez 40:31, 34, 37;1.  ascent of
† מַעֲרֶ֫כֶת  n.f. row, line;—only of the rows of ‘shew’-bread; abs. מ׳ Lv 24:7, מַעֲרָ֑כֶת v 6 (P); elsewhere Chr: לֶחֶ
† מָצוֹק  n.[m.] straitness, straits, stress;—always abs. מ׳;—כָּל־אִישׁ מ׳ 1 S 22:2 every man of straits (in straits);
† מְצוּקָה  n.f. id.;—abs. צַר וּמ׳ Jb 15:24; יוֹם צָרָה וּמ׳ Zp 1:15; pl. sf., of י׳ delivering מִמְּצוּקוֹתַי ψ 25:17,
† מַקֵּדָה  n.pr.loc. in Judah Jos 15:41, near Beth Horon Jos 10:10, and Libnah v 29, where was a cave v 16, 17, cf. v 2
† II. מִקְשָׁה  n.f. perhaps hammered work, only of metals (orig. turner’s work?);—abs. מ׳, of cherubim in tabern. Ex 25
